eng.intro:
Published by DOM publishers, Berlin, Germany  
  
This architectural guide presents over 100 sites in both Tunis and its surroundings. The Tunisian architect Faouzia Ben Khoud selects buildings from a long stretch of history: from the Phoenicians, who first founded a city there, to the Arab Spring, which began in Tunisia in 2010. Also covering recent renovation projects in detail, the author puts special emphasis on efforts to preserve the city’s exceptional cultural heritage. Available in English 978-3-86922-676-7 and French 978-3-86922-677-4.
eng.title: Architectural Guide Tunis
